headline: Stealth's surprise debut, OpenAI's flash gains reshape the leaderboard
summary: stealth/union-alpha crashed the top 10 with a 4.2% token share debut, while openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903 extended its all-time high streak to day 2 at 4.2%. DeepSeek still commands 22.7% overall, but the top four providers (DeepSeek, Tencent, Zhipu AI, OpenAI) now hold 63.1% of the market—a tightening grip on a consolidating landscape.
highlights: stealth/union-alpha vaults to rank 8 with 4.2% share—an all-time high for the provider
openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903 hits day 2 of its all-time share record at 4.2%, climbing 16 spots in a week
DeepSeek's three models occupy ranks 1, 4, and 23; the provider holds 22.7% but shed 2.3 points overnight
Tencent gains 1.1 points day-over-day; hy4-preview climbs to rank 2 with 9.9% share
OpenAI bounces back +2.0 points in a day despite gpt-5.6-luna losing 8.0 points over the week
Two new entrants (openai/gpt-5.6-luna-pro, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it) join the top 50; two dropouts exit
